title: Ông Già Xe Ôm Đến Trả Nợ
location: Tổng đài công ty Phú Quý trên tầng cao tòa tháp kính về đêm, phòng sếp vách kính có ring light; chiếc xe tải trắng đỗ dưới chân tòa nhà.
axis: Trong phòng sếp: Hưng và ring light luôn ở bên phải khung hình, ông Lâm và cửa thang máy ở bên trái. Trong xe tải: Mai ngồi bên trái, ông Khoa bên phải.
props: Điện thoại gắn gimbal tự sướng của Hưng (màn hình chỉ phát sáng), ring light, mũ cối xanh sờn của ông Lâm, ghế xoay mạ crôm, ổ cứng nhỏ màu đen, hai laptop phát sáng trong xe tải.
setting: Night in the loan app call center high in the glass tower: rows of desks with glowing monitors, magenta and gold neon accent lights without letters, city lights beyond the windows, a ring light glowing in the glass-walled boss room.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Tám giờ tối, như thường lệ, Hưng bật đèn livestream, hai triệu người đang chờ ông chủ Phú Quý lên sóng khoe tiền, thì đúng lúc ấy cửa thang máy mở, ông Lâm chậm rãi bước ra, mũ cối trên đầu, một mình, tay không.
beats: The glass-walled boss room at night, a dark ring light beside a white leather sofa, and beyond the glass a long aisle of glowing monitors ending at closed steel elevator doors, no person in frame.
@Hung strides in on screen-right, clicks the ring light into a bright white circle and lifts a phone on a small selfie gimbal to arm's length, lips pressed into a cocky closed-mouth grin.
Deep in the background beyond the glass, the elevator doors slide open and @Lam steps out alone on screen-left, battered green pith helmet on, both hands empty at his sides, lips closed.
@Lam walks slowly up the aisle toward the boss room between the glowing monitors, while @Hung in the foreground freezes mid-pose and glances back over his shoulder with his mouth shut.
clips.sfx: ring light switch clicking on, soft electronic hum, a few notification chimes, a distant elevator chime, sandals scuffing on carpet

turns.speaker: @Lam
turns.line: Cậu Hưng, tôi đến trả nợ cho cháu tôi, nhưng cậu phải nhận tiền trước mặt người xem.

turns.speaker: @Hung
turns.line: Cả nhà ơi, ông già xe ôm đến trả nợ này, mọi người xem ông ấy có quỳ xuống xin không nào!

beats: Inside the glass-walled boss room at night, the ring light glowing white beside the white leather sofa, the glass door standing open onto the neon call-center floor, no person in frame.
@Lam stands in the open glass doorway on screen-left and speaks in a calm husky voice, face and lips clearly visible, one finger tapping his pith helmet brim, while @Hung listens with closed lips.

@Lam closes his mouth and waits without blinking, as @Hung on screen-right swings the gimbal phone toward him and starts talking loudly into it like a livestream salesman, face and lips clearly visible.
@Hung finishes with a flourish of his ringed hand toward @Lam and closes his mouth in a smug grin, while @Lam stands perfectly still in the doorway, empty hands relaxed.
clips.sfx: ring light hum, distant keyboard clicks, a rising flurry of notification chimes, the glass door settling on its hinge

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Ông Lâm không quỳ, ông kéo ghế ngồi xuống, gác mũ cối lên đùi, tự rót cho mình một chén trà nóng, bình thản như đang ngồi quán trà đá đầu ngõ, còn Hưng thì đứng ngẩn ra trước ống kính, chẳng biết phải nói gì tiếp.
beats: @Lam ignores the raised gimbal, walks past @Hung to the wide glass desk and pulls out the chrome swivel chair with one hand, lips closed.
@Lam sits down unhurried on screen-left, rests his battered green pith helmet on his knee and pours himself a small cup of tea from the teapot on the desk.
@Lam crosses one leg over the other and leans back easily with the steaming cup in both hands, a faint knowing smile on closed lips, like an old man at a street tea stall.
@Hung stands frozen under the white ring light on screen-right, gimbal still raised and mouth shut, blinking down at the old man who calmly cradles his tea.
clips.sfx: chair wheels rolling on the floor, leather creaking, tea trickling into a small cup, ring light hum, scattered notification chimes

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Dưới chân tòa nhà, trong chiếc xe tải trắng, Mai gõ phím như bay, còn ông Khoa đã cắm sẵn ổ cứng thật lấy ra từ bụng chiếc đài Liên Xô cũ, cả hai chỉ còn chờ ông Lâm ra hiệu là bấm nút.
beats: Inside the parked white van at night, two laptops glowing blank on a fold-out desk among tangled cables, a thermos and an old wooden Soviet-era radio with its back panel open, no person in frame.
@Mai on screen-left types at lightning speed, her round glasses lit by the blank glowing screens, lips pressed together in concentration.
@Khoa on screen-right lifts a small black hard drive out of the opened radio and clicks it into the side of a laptop, his magnifier glasses pulled down over his eyes.
@Khoa gives a closed-mouth wink and a thumbs-up, and @Mai hovers one finger above the enter key without pressing it, both faces lit by the glow as neon slides over the tinted windows.
clips.sfx: rapid keyboard clatter, a plug clicking into a port, a soft confirmation beep, muffled street traffic outside
clips.setting: Inside a parked white van turned into a surveillance post at night: two laptops glowing, tangled cables, a thermos, tinted windows with neon reflections.

title: Buổi Livestream Định Mệnh
location: Phòng sếp vách kính của Hưng trong tổng đài Phú Quý về đêm, và chiếc xe tải trắng dưới chân tòa nhà.
axis: Ông Lâm ngồi ghế crôm bên trái khung hình, Hưng cầm gimbal đứng bên phải dưới ring light. Trong xe tải: Mai ngồi bên trái trước laptop.
props: Điện thoại gắn gimbal (màn hình chỉ nhấp nháy ánh sáng, không chữ), ring light, ghế xoay crôm, chén trà nóng và mũ cối xanh sờn trên bàn kính, laptop phát sáng trong xe tải.
setting: Night in the loan app call center high in the glass tower: rows of desks with glowing monitors, magenta and gold neon accent lights without letters, city lights beyond the windows, a ring light glowing in the glass-walled boss room.

turns.speaker: @Lam
turns.line: Cháu tôi vay năm triệu, ba tháng thành trăm rưỡi, cậu tính lãi bao nhiêu một ngày thế?

turns.speaker: @Hung
turns.line: Ba phần trăm một ngày, không trả thì tôi gửi ảnh cho cả họ hàng nó, luật nào cấm được tôi?

beats: The glass-walled boss room at night, the ring light glowing over a wide glass desk with a steaming teacup beside an empty chrome chair, magenta neon beyond the glass, no person in frame.
@Lam sits calmly in the chrome chair on screen-left, pith helmet on his knee, and asks in a husky steady voice, face and lips clearly visible, while @Hung films him with closed lips.
@Lam closes his mouth and tilts his head patiently, as @Hung on screen-right leans into the gimbal lens and answers loudly and smugly, face and lips clearly visible in the ring light.
@Hung wags three ringed fingers in the air as he finishes, then closes his mouth in a cocky grin, gold-rimmed glasses flashing, while @Lam sits motionless with his hands on his knees.
clips.sfx: ring light hum, distant keyboard clicks, notification chimes multiplying, a leather chair creaking

turns.speaker: @Lam
turns.line: Cậu nói to lên một chút nữa, để hai triệu người đang xem cùng nghe cho rõ.

turns.speaker: @Hung
turns.line: Cả nhà nghe rõ chưa, ba phần trăm một ngày, đứa nào không trả là tôi bêu ảnh lên mạng!

beats: @Lam sets his teacup down on the glass desk with a soft click and looks up at @Hung, lips closed, as the camera begins to arc around the glowing ring light.
@Lam speaks calmly up at @Hung, face and lips clearly visible, one weathered hand gesturing gently toward the glowing gimbal phone, while @Hung listens with closed lips.
@Lam closes his mouth and leans back, as @Hung swings the gimbal up to his own face and repeats his boast even louder, face and lips clearly visible, chin raised high.
@Hung finishes, closes his mouth and spreads his ringed hands wide for the lens, while @Lam folds his arms on screen-left with a slow closed-mouth smile.
clips.sfx: a teacup clicking on glass, ring light hum, a sudden flood of notification chimes, the distant drone of the city

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Đúng lúc ấy, trong xe tải, Mai bấm nút, buổi livestream của Hưng lập tức bị chia đôi, một nửa là gương mặt hắn đang vênh váo khoe lãi, nửa kia là danh sách mấy nghìn nạn nhân thật lấy thẳng từ máy chủ Phú Quý.
beats: Extreme close-up of a laptop keyboard inside the parked white van at night, the blank screen's glow pulsing over the keys beside tangled cables and a thermos, no person in frame.
@Mai's finger presses the enter key firmly and the blank screen glow flares brighter, flooding her round glasses as the camera pulls back to her face.
The two blank laptop screens beside her pulse in alternating bands of white and red light across @Mai's face, her lips pressed into a tight line.
@Mai leans back in her seat with a small closed-mouth smile, the laptop light flickering over her lavender hoodie and neon sliding across the tinted window behind her.
clips.sfx: a single decisive key click, a rising electronic chime, rapid soft beeps, muffled street traffic
clips.setting: Inside a parked white van turned into a surveillance post at night: two laptops glowing, tangled cables, a thermos, tinted windows with neon reflections.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Điện thoại của Hưng rung liên hồi, bình luận chửi rủa trôi như thác, số người xem vọt lên năm triệu, hắn quay sang thì ông già xe ôm vẫn ngồi yên đó, nhấp một ngụm trà, mỉm cười như chưa hề có chuyện gì.
beats: Close on the white ring light and the empty white leather sofa in the boss room at night, the neon of the call center pulsing through the glass wall, no person in frame.
@Hung steps into the ring light as the gimbal phone buzzes nonstop in his hand, its blank screen strobing white and red light across his frozen grin and sweating temple.
@Hung slowly turns his head toward screen-left, and focus shifts to the foreground, where @Lam sits in the chrome chair raising a small steaming teacup.
@Lam sets the cup down on the glass desk with a calm closed-mouth smile, as if nothing at all has happened, while @Hung stands frozen in soft focus behind him.
clips.sfx: a phone buzzing nonstop, a torrent of rapid notification pings, ring light hum, a teacup set gently on glass

title: Đế Chế Sụp Đổ
location: Tổng đài Phú Quý về đêm: nhân viên lần lượt bỏ về, sàn văn phòng trống dần, phòng sếp vách kính và thang máy cuối lối đi.
axis: Lối đi chính chạy từ thang máy (cuối khung hình) về phía phòng sếp (gần máy quay). Ở cửa phòng sếp: Hưng bên phải, Béo bên trái.
props: Tai nghe bỏ lại trên bàn, ghế trống còn xoay, màn hình sáng trống, điện thoại của Béo chỉ phát sáng, chén trà cạn, mũ cối xanh sờn.
setting: Night in the loan app call center high in the glass tower: rows of desks with glowing monitors, magenta and gold neon accent lights without letters, city lights beyond the windows, a ring light glowing in the glass-walled boss room.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Trong phòng gọi điện, từng nhân viên một lặng lẽ tháo tai nghe, đứng dậy xách túi bỏ về, những chiếc ghế trống cứ thế xoay tròn, chẳng ai còn muốn dính vào cái công ty sắp sập ấy thêm một phút nào nữa.
beats: Wide view of the night call center, rows of desks with blank glowing monitors under magenta and gold neon, young callers in headsets sitting stock-still at their screens.
One by one the young callers pull off their headsets, lay them on the desks and stand up, picking up their bags with mouths closed.
The callers walk out in a quiet line between the desks toward the far elevator, never once looking back at the glass-walled boss room.
Rows of empty chairs slowly turn under the glowing monitors as the camera rises over the deserted floor, abandoned headsets glinting in the neon.
clips.sfx: headsets clattering softly onto desks, chairs rolling back, quiet footsteps, a distant elevator chime
clips.extras: young callers pulling off their headsets and walking out between the desks

clips.speaker: @Hung
clips.line: Ngồi xuống hết! Đứa nào bước ra khỏi cửa là tao trừ hết lương, nghe chưa? Tao trả tiền cho chúng mày để ngồi gọi điện, chứ không phải để đứng dậy bỏ về như thế!
beats: The emptying call-center floor at night, abandoned headsets on the desks and chairs left askew under blank glowing monitors, magenta neon pulsing, no person in frame.
@Hung bursts out of the glass boss-room door into the aisle and yells after the departing callers, face and lips clearly visible, one ringed hand raised high.
@Hung keeps shouting and points at the empty desks, gold-rimmed glasses askew, while far behind him the last young callers step into the elevator without turning around.
@Hung closes his mouth and stands panting alone in the empty aisle, satin bomber jacket rumpled, as the steel elevator doors slide shut in the distance.
clips.sfx: a glass door swinging open, a lone chair slowly spinning, monitor hum, elevator doors sliding closed
clips.extras: the last few young callers walking away toward the elevator with their bags

turns.speaker: @Beo
turns.line: Đại ca ơi, cả mạng đang chia sẻ lại buổi phát trực tiếp, công an kinh tế đang lên tận đây rồi!

turns.speaker: @Hung
turns.line: Gọi hết anh em ra chặn cổng, tuyệt đối đừng để lão già ấy ra khỏi tòa nhà này!

beats: The doorway of the glass-walled boss room at night, the ring light still glowing over the white leather sofa, the long empty aisle stretching back to the elevator, no person in frame.
@Beo skids to a stop in the doorway on screen-left, pale and dripping sweat, holds up a glowing phone and blurts out the news, face and lips clearly visible, while @Hung listens.
@Beo closes his mouth and wipes his shaved head, as @Hung on screen-right turns sharply toward him and barks orders, face and lips clearly visible, glasses catching the ring light.
@Hung finishes, pointing a ringed finger toward the elevator, then closes his mouth and breathes hard, while @Beo nods rapidly with closed lips and backs out of the doorway.
clips.sfx: heavy running footsteps, flip-flops flapping, a phone buzzing nonstop, a distant siren far below

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Giữa lúc cả đế chế Phú Quý đang sụp đổ, ông Lâm đứng dậy, đội lại mũ cối, xếp lại chén trà cho ngay ngắn, rồi thong thả bước vào thang máy, như một ông khách quen vừa uống xong ấm trà ở quán nước đầu ngõ.
beats: A small empty teacup on the glass desk beside the chrome chair in the boss room, the ring light glowing and the deserted call-center floor visible beyond the glass, no person in frame.
@Lam rises from the chrome chair, settles a battered green pith helmet on his head and sets the empty teacup neatly upside down on its saucer, lips closed.
@Lam strolls unhurried out of the boss room and down the empty aisle between the glowing monitors, hands clasped behind his back, plastic sandals scuffing the carpet.
@Lam steps into the waiting elevator, turns to face the camera and gives a small closed-mouth nod as the steel doors slide shut in front of him.
clips.sfx: a teacup set down on glass, unhurried sandal footsteps, an elevator chime, doors sliding closed

title: Phố Cổ Đứng Dậy
location: Con phố rộng trước tòa tháp kính về đêm; người phố cổ kéo đến đứng kín hai bên vỉa hè.
axis: Lối vào tòa tháp ở giữa khung hình, vòng xe máy của đàn em đỗ cách cửa kính vài mét. Xích lô và người phố cổ đứng dọc hai vỉa hè trái phải; không ai lại gần ai, không ai chạm vào ai.
props: Hai chục xe máy đen đèn pha chói, hàng chục chiếc xích lô, quạt nan của bà Hoa, mũ cối xanh sờn của ông Lâm.
setting: Night on the wide street in front of the glass tower: neon reflections on the asphalt, tall trees, parked motorbikes, warm streetlamps.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Dưới sảnh, hai chục đàn em của Béo rồ ga chắn kín lối ra, đèn xe chói lòa cả góc phố, thế mà ông Lâm vẫn bước ra một mình, đứng giữa vòng vây, không lùi một bước, chỉ khẽ nâng vành mũ cối.
beats: High wide view of the empty night street in front of the gleaming glass tower, neon reflections rippling on the asphalt under warm streetlamps and tall trees, no person in frame.
Twenty young debt collectors in black roll their motorbikes into a wide half-circle a good distance from the tower's glass doors, revving engines, headlights flaring into a wall of white glare.
The glass doors part and @Lam walks out alone into the glare, pith helmet on and hands empty, and stops on the pavement far from the idling motorbikes.
@Lam stands perfectly still inside the distant ring of headlights and slowly lifts the brim of his battered green pith helmet with one finger, calm narrow eyes steady and lips closed.
clips.sfx: a chorus of revving motorbike engines, horns blaring, glass doors sliding apart, engines settling into an idle
clips.extras: twenty young debt collectors in black on motorbikes revving and blocking the tower entrance

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Rồi từ hai đầu phố, hàng chục chiếc xích lô của các bác già phố cổ chậm rãi đạp tới, các bà bán hàng, các ông xe ôm cũng lần lượt bước ra, đứng kín hai bên vỉa hè, không ai nói một lời.
beats: Aerial view down the long neon-lit street at night, warm streetlamps and tall trees lining both sidewalks, the white glare of the motorbike half-circle burning in front of the glass tower.
From both ends of the street, dozens of cyclos pedaled by old drivers in faded shirts and conical hats roll in slowly side by side, their bells tinkling.
The cyclos glide to a quiet stop in two long lines along the curbs, as shop doors swing open and shopkeepers in aprons and motorbike-taxi drivers in pith helmets step out.
The silent crowd stands shoulder to shoulder along both sidewalks with arms folded and mouths closed, every gaze turned toward the glass tower under the neon.
clips.sfx: dozens of cyclo bells tinkling, bicycle chains clicking, shop doors creaking open, shuffling sandals, then a deep hush over idling engines
clips.extras: dozens of cyclos pedaled by old drivers rolling in from both ends of the street, and old-quarter shopkeepers and motorbike-taxi drivers lining the sidewalks in silence

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Đi đầu là bà Hoa, son đỏ chót, tay phe phẩy quạt nan, bà chẳng nói câu nào, chỉ đứng nhìn lũ đàn em như nhìn một mẻ chả sắp cháy trên bếp than, thế là đủ cho chúng nó lạnh hết cả gáy.
beats: The neon-lit sidewalk under tall trees at night, streetlamp light pooling on the paving stones and exhaust haze drifting through the white glare of headlights, no person in frame.
@BaHoa strides into frame at the head of the crowd, waving a woven bamboo hand fan in slow lazy strokes, red lips pressed together, gold hoop earrings swinging.
@BaHoa stops at the curb, plants one hand on her hip and looks slowly across the ring of motorbikes, her chunky gold bangle glinting in the headlight glare.
@BaHoa lowers her chin and narrows her sharp eyes toward screen-right with a closed-mouth smirk, fanning herself like a cook eyeing a grill about to burn.
clips.sfx: the soft flap of a bamboo hand fan, heeled sandals clicking, idling engines sputtering, a hush over the street

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Béo nhìn quanh, xích lô kín đường, người kín vỉa hè, đám đàn em lần lượt dắt xe lùi lại, rồi từng đứa một lặng lẽ chuồn mất, bỏ lại mình hắn đứng trơ trọi giữa phố với sợi dây chuyền vàng giả lấp lánh.
beats: The wide street in front of the glass tower at night, neon reflections on the asphalt and the white glare of motorbike headlights beneath the tall trees, no person in frame.
@Beo stands in the middle of the street turning his shaved head left and right, small eyes darting toward the silent crowds and cyclos lining both sidewalks, lips pressed shut.
Behind @Beo, the young debt collectors quietly walk their motorbikes backward, then turn and slip away one by one into the dark side streets.
@Beo stands alone in the emptied street under a streetlamp, his cheap fake-gold chain glinting on his black tank top, swallowing hard with his mouth shut.
clips.sfx: motorbike engines cutting off one by one, tires rolling softly backward, footsteps fading, a lonely cricket chirping
clips.extras: young debt collectors walking their motorbikes backward behind him and slipping away

title: Siêu Xe Kẹt Giờ Tan Tầm
location: Hầm xe tòa tháp kính, rồi đại lộ Hà Nội giờ tan tầm buổi tối; cây cầu sắt bên sông ở cuối đường.
axis: Dòng xe chảy từ trái sang phải khung hình; siêu xe đỏ kẹt giữa dòng, ông Lâm luồn lách từ phía sau tiến lên; cây cầu sắt ở phía xa bên phải.
props: Xe thể thao đỏ thấp không logo, chiếc xe máy cũ màu kem đèn pha tròn mạ crôm, mũ cối xanh sờn, điện thoại của Hưng chỉ phát sáng.
setting: Evening rush hour on a wide Hà Nội avenue: a dense river of motorbikes and cars, red taillights, neon and streetlamps, trees along the sidewalks.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Hưng chạy xuống hầm, nhảy lên chiếc xe thể thao đỏ, rú ga phóng ra cửa sau tòa nhà, hắn tin rằng chiếc siêu xe mấy tỷ của mình thừa sức bỏ xa một lão già xe ôm với cái xe máy cũ mèm.
beats: A dim underground car park with concrete pillars and flickering fluorescent strip lights, a low red sports car with no badge parked alone with its paint gleaming, no person in frame.
@Hung runs in between the pillars clutching his glowing phone, flings the car door open and drops into the low driver's seat, mouth clamped shut.
The headlights snap on and the low red sports car pulls out of its bay, swinging toward the exit ramp with its engine screaming through the empty car park.
The red taillights streak away up the ramp toward a sliver of neon night at the top, leaving exhaust haze curling under the fluorescent lights.
clips.sfx: hurried sneaker footsteps on concrete, a car door thudding shut, a high-pitched engine roar, tires squealing
clips.setting: A dim underground car park with concrete pillars and fluorescent strip lights, a low red sports car with no badge.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Nhưng đây là Hà Nội giờ tan tầm, chiếc siêu xe đỏ chói chỉ nhích được vài mét giữa biển xe máy, còn một bà cụ chở cả xe hoa vẫn thong thả vượt qua mặt nó, lại còn bấm còi chào một tiếng.
beats: Top-down aerial view of a wide Hà Nội avenue at evening rush hour, a dense river of motorbikes crawling under neon and streetlamps, red taillights glowing.
In the middle of the motorbike river, a low red sports car with no badge sits wedged in place, tinted windows dark, inching forward a hand's width at a time while scooters stream around it.
An old woman in a conical hat on a scooter loaded with a tall tower of potted flowers putters past the stranded sports car at an easy pace and gives one cheerful honk.
The camera sinks toward the gleaming red hood as its hazard lights blink helplessly, the sea of motorbikes flowing on all around it under the neon.
clips.sfx: a sea of beeping scooter horns, idling engines, a sports car engine revving uselessly, one long comic honk
clips.extras: a dense crowd of evening commuters on motorbikes in helmets and face masks, among them an old woman with a scooter full of potted flowers, seen from above

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Phía sau, ông Lâm trên chiếc xe máy cũ lách qua dòng xe như cá lội, ba mươi năm chạy xe ôm, ngõ ngách nào của Hà Nội ông cũng thuộc như lòng bàn tay, mỗi lúc một gần chiếc siêu xe đỏ chói.
beats: A narrow gap snaking between rows of idling motorbike taillights and chrome mirrors on the jammed avenue at evening rush hour, neon and streetlamps glowing, no person in frame.
@Lam threads into the gap on the old cream-colored step-through motorbike with a round chrome headlamp, battered green pith helmet low, slipping between the lanes like a fish through reeds.
@Lam glides past the stalled commuters with steady hands and a polite tap of his little horn, eyes fixed ahead and lips closed, never brushing a single mirror.
Far ahead through the traffic, the low red sports car with no badge glows under the streetlamps as @Lam's round chrome headlamp closes in steadily behind it.
clips.sfx: an old engine puttering steadily, a cheerful little horn beep, a sea of idling engines and horns
clips.extras: evening commuters on motorbikes stalled around him, faces hidden by helmets and face masks

clips.speaker: @Lam
clips.line: Chạy bộ lên cầu mà đòi thoát Lâm Rồng à? Ba mươi năm trước ông phóng xe trên cây cầu ấy còn nhiều hơn cậu đi thang máy, thằng nhóc này còn non lắm.
beats: The gleaming roof and dark tinted windows of the low red sports car with no badge, stranded at the curb of the jammed avenue, red taillights blurring all around it, no person in frame.
On screen-left, @Lam sits on the old cream-colored step-through motorbike with a round chrome headlamp and starts talking to himself, face and lips clearly visible, as @Hung jumps out of the red car.
@Hung sprints away along the tree-lined sidewalk toward a distant steel truss bridge, clutching his glowing phone, while @Lam keeps talking with a dry chuckle and slowly shakes his head.
@Lam finishes, closes his mouth, tugs the strap of his battered green pith helmet tight and twists the throttle with a small sly grin.
clips.sfx: an old engine puttering, a car door swinging open, sneakers slapping the pavement, distant horns, the motorbike revving

title: Trên Cây Cầu Sắt
location: Giữa cây cầu sắt trăm tuổi bắc qua sông rộng về đêm, trên làn xe máy hẹp cạnh đường ray.
axis: Ông Lâm luôn ở bên trái khung hình (phía đầu cầu vừa tới), Hưng ở bên phải (phía giữa cầu, ánh đèn công an xanh đỏ nhấp nháy xa sau lưng hắn). Hai người cách nhau vài bước, không ai chạm vào ai.
props: Chiếc xe máy cũ màu kem đèn pha tròn mạ crôm, mũ cối xanh sờn cầm trên tay, hình xăm rồng xanh sẫm trên cẳng tay phải ông Lâm, điện thoại gắn gimbal của Hưng.
setting: Night on a century-old steel truss railway bridge over a wide dark river: rusty iron lattice beams lit by sparse lamps, a narrow motorbike lane beside the tracks, city lights on the far bank.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Cây cầu sắt trăm tuổi, nơi ba mươi năm trước Lâm Rồng từng làm mưa làm gió, đêm nay lại chứng kiến một cuộc rượt đuổi, Hưng chạy đến giữa cầu thì khựng lại, phía bên kia đèn công an đã chắn kín lối.
beats: A century-old steel truss railway bridge spanning a wide dark river at night, its rusty iron lattice lit by sparse lamps and city lights shimmering on the far bank, no person in frame.
The camera glides down along the bridge's long iron spine toward the narrow motorbike lane beside the tracks, lamplight pooling on the rails as river mist drifts through the beams.
@Hung runs into frame along the motorbike lane, panting, phone clutched to his chest, then skids to a halt in the middle of the span.
@Hung stares ahead with his mouth clamped shut as blue and red lights flash far away at the end of the bridge, sealing the way down, no figures visible there.
clips.sfx: wind whistling through iron girders, the river lapping far below, sneakers pounding on iron plates, a distant police siren whooping softly

clips.speaker: @Hung
clips.line: Ông nghĩ ông là cái thá gì mà dám chơi tôi? Bố tôi bảo ông từng là Lâm Rồng gì đấy, nhưng giờ ông chỉ là một lão già chạy xe ôm hết thời thôi!
beats: Low view down the motorbike lane of the old steel truss bridge at night, a warm round headlamp approaching slowly out of the dark between the rusty iron beams, no person visible.

@Lam rolls to a stop on screen-left on the old cream-colored step-through motorbike with a round chrome headlamp, and @Hung on screen-right spins around and yells at him, face and lips clearly visible.
@Hung keeps shouting with one ringed finger pointed, ash-blond hair wind-tossed and glasses askew, while @Lam calmly sets the motorbike on its stand and swings one leg off.
@Hung closes his mouth, chest heaving, as @Lam lifts the battered green pith helmet off his grey crew cut and holds it at his side under a bridge lamp, lips closed.
clips.sfx: an old engine puttering to a stop, the metal clack of a side stand, wind howling through iron girders, ragged breathing

clips.speaker: @Lam
clips.line: Bố cậu chưa kể hết à? Ba mươi năm trước, phố cổ này là của Rồng, giờ vẫn thế, mà Rồng thì chưa bao giờ phải động đến một ngón tay, cậu ạ.
beats: Close on @Lam's right forearm as he silently rolls up his sleeve fold by fold, revealing a coiled dark-green dragon tattoo gleaming under the bridge lamp, his lips closed.
The camera tilts up to @Lam's face as he lowers the tattooed arm and speaks to @Hung in a calm husky voice, face and lips clearly visible, the lamp haloing his grey crew cut.
@Lam keeps talking evenly, one weathered finger resting on the dragon on his forearm, calm narrow eyes never leaving @Hung, who stands frozen in soft focus on screen-right.
@Lam finishes with a slow nod and closes his mouth, while @Hung takes a shaky step back with lips pressed tight and knuckles white around his phone.
clips.sfx: the soft rustle of a rolled sleeve, wind whistling through the iron lattice, the deep rumble of the river, distant sirens drawing closer

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Hưng lùi lại đến sát lan can, chiếc điện thoại tuột khỏi tay rơi tõm xuống dòng sông, nhưng muộn rồi, năm triệu người xem đã kịp thấy hết, nghe hết, và cả đế chế Phú Quý cũng chìm nghỉm theo nó trong làn nước đen.
beats: @Hung backs away step by step until his back meets the rusty iron railing of the bridge, mouth shut, the wide dark river glittering far below.
The phone on its small selfie gimbal slips from @Hung's trembling fingers and tumbles over the railing, its blank screen still glowing as it spins down through the dark.
The glowing phone vanishes into the black river with a tiny splash, its light winking out beneath the rippling reflections of the city.
@Hung leans on the railing staring down at the spreading ripples with his mouth shut, a small lone figure on the vast lamp-lit iron bridge.
clips.sfx: a sharp gasp, the clatter of a gimbal on iron, a faint distant splash, wind and rushing water

title: Kẻ Đòi Nợ Bị Đòi Nợ
location: Cây cầu sắt về đêm; văn phòng Phú Quý trống trơn; sân trường đại học và nhà ông Lâm sáng hôm sau.
axis: Trên cầu: công an đi tới từ bên trái, Hưng đứng bên phải cạnh lan can, không ai chạm vào ai. Ở nhà: Mai bên trái, ông Lâm bên phải bàn gỗ.
props: Đèn xanh đỏ nhấp nháy xa, điện thoại chỉ phát sáng, chén trà, mũ cối xanh sờn, bàn gỗ cũ, bàn thờ nhỏ.
setting: Night on a century-old steel truss railway bridge over a wide dark river: rusty iron lattice beams lit by sparse lamps, a narrow motorbike lane beside the tracks, city lights on the far bank.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Trên cầu, hai cán bộ công an thong thả bước tới, Hưng tự giơ hai tay ra trước mặt, gương mặt kiêu ngạo của ông chủ Phú Quý giờ trắng bệch như tờ giấy, chẳng còn nụ cười nào để livestream cho ai xem nữa.
beats: The middle span of the old steel truss bridge at night, blue and red lights washing softly over the rusty iron lattice and the empty motorbike lane, no person in frame.
@Hung stands alone by the railing on screen-right as two police officers in green uniforms walk up calmly from screen-left and stop a few steps away, hands relaxed at their sides.
@Hung slowly raises both his own hands and offers them out in front of him, ringed fingers trembling, face drained pale and lips pressed shut, while the officers wait without moving.
@Hung lowers his head, ash-blond hair falling over his gold-rimmed glasses, a small figure under the bridge lamp as the blue and red light keeps washing over him.
clips.sfx: calm footsteps on iron plates, a police radio crackling softly, wind through the girders, the river below
clips.extras: two police officers in green uniforms walking up calmly

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Còn ở văn phòng Phú Quý, Béo Đầu Sấm ngồi bệt dưới sàn, ôm khư khư cái điện thoại, mếu máo như đứa trẻ lạc mẹ, bên cạnh là một chú công an kiên nhẫn đứng chờ, chẳng buồn nói với hắn câu nào.
beats: The deserted call-center floor at night, rows of empty desks and blank glowing monitors under magenta and gold neon, headsets scattered across the desks, no person in frame.
@Beo sits slumped on the floor between the desks hugging his glowing phone to his chest, his closed lips wobbling into a pout like a lost child.
A police officer in a green uniform stands calmly a few steps away with hands behind his back, looking down at @Beo without a word.
@Beo sniffles and wipes his eyes with his wrist, his cheap fake-gold chain glinting, heavy shoulders sagging under the pulsing magenta neon.
clips.sfx: a loud sniffle, monitor hum, a police radio crackling softly, the whine of the air conditioner
clips.setting: Night in the loan app call center high in the glass tower: rows of desks with glowing monitors, magenta and gold neon accent lights without letters, city lights beyond the windows, a ring light glowing in the glass-walled boss room.
clips.extras: a police officer standing calmly nearby

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Sáng hôm sau, ứng dụng Phú Quý bị khóa, hàng nghìn sinh viên được xóa nợ, nhiều đứa ôm nhau khóc giữa sân trường, còn Mai mở điện thoại, lần đầu sau ba tháng, không còn cuộc gọi lạ nào, chỉ có tin nhắn cảm ơn của bạn bè.
beats: Aerial view of a sunny university schoolyard in the morning, tall trees casting dappled shade over the paving and old yellow buildings with green shutters all around, no person in frame.
Groups of students gather under the trees staring down at their blank glowing phone screens, then lift their heads and wrap one another in silent tearful hugs.
The drone descends toward a bench under a tall tree where @Mai sits in her lavender hoodie, turning over her phone and looking at its softly glowing screen.
@Mai lets out a long breath, eyes glistening behind her round glasses, a closed-mouth smile spreading across her face as she presses the phone to her chest.
clips.sfx: birdsong, rustling leaves, soft sniffles, a chorus of gentle message chimes
clips.setting: A sunny university schoolyard in the morning with tall trees and old yellow buildings.
clips.extras: groups of students looking at their phones and hugging each other

turns.speaker: @Mai
turns.line: Ông ơi, cả lớp cháu bảo ông là ông nội ngầu nhất cái Hà Nội này đấy ông ạ!

turns.speaker: @Lam
turns.line: Ngầu gì, ông chỉ là ông già xe ôm, mai ông còn phải chở cụ Tý đi chợ sớm.

beats: Morning inside the narrow tube house, sunlight spilling over the worn wooden table and the small family altar, the rolling steel shutter raised to the street, no person in frame.
@Mai hops onto the stool on screen-left beside @Lam and tells him the news with a beaming grin, face and lips clearly visible, holding up her glowing phone, while @Lam listens.
@Mai closes her mouth and nudges her glasses up, as @Lam on screen-right sets down his teacup, waves the compliment away and answers in a dry husky voice, face and lips clearly visible.
@Lam finishes with a modest shrug and closes his mouth, putting on his battered green pith helmet to hide a little smile, while @Mai covers her grin with her hand.
clips.sfx: morning street bustle, birdsong, a teacup clinking on wood, a motorbike horn outside
clips.setting: Morning inside Lâm's narrow old-quarter tube house: a ground-floor room with the rolling steel shutter raised, a worn wooden table, a small family altar, sunlight from the street.

title: Đôi Mắt Sáng Lại
location: Phòng bệnh viện mắt sáng sủa buổi sáng, cửa phòng nhìn ra hành lang trắng.
axis: Giường bệnh giữa khung hình, cửa sổ lớn phía sau; ông Lâm ngồi trên giường bên phải, Mai đứng bên trái giường. Ở cửa phòng: bà Hoa bên trái, ông Khoa bên phải.
props: Bình giữ nhiệt, lọ hoa cúc trắng, quà của phố cổ (túi cam, rổ rau thơm, hộp cơm), cuộn băng gạc trên khay inox, quạt nan của bà Hoa.
setting: A bright, clean eye-hospital room in the morning: a white bed, a big window full of sunlight, a small bedside table with a thermos and a vase of daisies.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Một tuần sau, tiền mổ mắt cho ông Lâm do cả phố cổ góp lại, người một ít, bác xích lô góp mấy buổi chạy xe, bà bán xôi góp cả tháng lãi, còn bà Hoa góp nhiều nhất, nhưng cấm ai được kể cho ông nghe.
beats: A bright, clean eye-hospital room in the morning, sunlight pouring through the big window over an empty white bed with neatly folded sheets.
The camera glides toward the bedside table crowded with gifts from the old quarter: a thermos, a vase of daisies, a bag of oranges, a basket of fresh herbs and a tin lunchbox.
Beside the gifts sit a brass cyclo bell, a bundle of sticky rice wrapped in banana leaf and a folded paper with faint unreadable lines, all glowing in the morning sun.
The camera settles on a woven bamboo hand fan resting on top of the pile of gifts, glowing in a warm sunbeam beside the daisies.
clips.sfx: a soft hospital hum, birdsong outside the window, a curtain rustling in the breeze

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Cô y tá từ từ tháo băng, ông Lâm chớp mắt mấy lần trong ánh nắng sớm, mọi thứ mờ mờ rồi rõ dần, lần đầu sau bao nhiêu năm, ông nhìn rõ từng chiếc lá ngoài cửa sổ, và cả người đang đứng bên giường.
beats: Sunlight glowing through the big window of the bright eye-hospital room onto a small steel tray holding a roll of white gauze, no person in frame.
@Lam sits up in the white bed with a gauze bandage over his eyes as a nurse in white scrubs, seen from behind, gently unwinds it layer by layer.
The last layer comes away and @Lam blinks several times into the flood of morning light, his once-cloudy left eye now clear, gazing at the leaves outside the window.
@Lam slowly turns his head toward the bedside on screen-left, eyes widening and glistening, a slow closed-mouth smile spreading across his weathered face.
clips.sfx: the soft rustle of unwinding gauze, birdsong, a gentle hospital hum, a deep slow breath
clips.extras: a nurse in white scrubs seen from behind

turns.speaker: @Lam
turns.line: Cháu ông xinh thế này mà mấy năm nay ông chỉ nhìn thấy lờ mờ, phí quá con ạ.

turns.speaker: @Mai
turns.line: Thế thì ông ngắm cháu cả đời đi, từ nay cháu không để ông phải lo nữa đâu.

beats: The bedside of the bright eye-hospital room, sunlight streaming through the big window behind a vase of daisies on the small bedside table, no person in frame.
@Lam sits up in the white bed on screen-right and looks at @Mai with clear bright eyes, speaking softly in his husky voice, face and lips clearly visible, while @Mai listens with closed lips.
@Lam closes his mouth with a teasing smile, as @Mai on screen-left, red-rimmed eyes glistening behind her round glasses, answers through her tears, face and lips clearly visible.
@Mai finishes, closes her mouth and wipes her eyes under her glasses with a silent laugh, while @Lam watches her with a warm closed-mouth smile in the sunlight.
clips.sfx: birdsong, a soft sniffle, a curtain swaying in the breeze, distant street horns

turns.speaker: @BaHoa
turns.line: Mắt sáng rồi thì nhớ trả tôi tiền bún chả ba mươi năm nay ông ăn chịu đấy nhé!

turns.speaker: @Khoa
turns.line: Bà ấy nói đùa đấy, thực ra bà ấy khóc cả đêm qua vì lo cho ông đấy.

beats: The doorway of the bright eye-hospital room in morning light, a clean white corridor stretching behind it and sunlight on the tiled floor, no person in frame.
@BaHoa sweeps into the doorway on screen-left with @Khoa beside her on screen-right and calls toward the bed in a brassy teasing voice, face and red lips clearly visible, bamboo fan in hand.
@BaHoa closes her mouth and arches one eyebrow, as @Khoa leans toward the bed with a hand cupped beside his mouth and speaks in a dry nasal deadpan, face and lips clearly visible.
@Khoa finishes with a sly closed-mouth wink, while @BaHoa flicks her bamboo fan open in front of her face to hide her reddening cheeks, lips pressed tight.
clips.sfx: heeled sandals clicking on tile, a bamboo fan flicking open, a stifled sniff, a quiet hospital corridor hum
clips.setting: The doorway of the bright eye-hospital room, a white corridor behind, morning light.

title: Găng Tơ Tái Xuất
location: Cổng Ô Quan Chưởng nắng vàng buổi sáng, quán bún chả bà Hoa, cổng trường đại học và toàn cảnh phố cổ từ trên cao.
axis: Cổng gạch cổ ở giữa khung hình, chiếc xe máy cũ đỗ dưới vòm cổng; ông Lâm bên trái, cậu thanh niên tiến lại từ bên phải. Ở quán bún chả: bà Hoa bên trái, ông Khoa bên phải.
props: Chiếc xe máy cũ màu kem đèn pha tròn mạ crôm, mũ cối xanh sờn, tờ hóa đơn giấy không chữ, laptop của Mai chỉ phát sáng.
setting: Dawn in Hà Nội's old quarter: an ancient brick city gate with a tiled roof, narrow streets of tube houses with green shutters, tangled overhead wires, street vendors with shoulder poles, pink-gold morning light.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Sáng hôm sau, phố cổ lại bình yên như cũ, ở quán bún chả, bà Hoa và ông Khoa lại tranh nhau trả tiền chầu sáng, tờ hóa đơn bị kéo qua kéo lại, ba mươi năm rồi mà Hổ với Báo vẫn chưa phân thắng bại.
beats: A steel table at the bustling bún chả shop with bowls of noodles, a basket of fresh herbs and a small paper bill with faint unreadable lines, charcoal smoke drifting, no person in frame.
@BaHoa and @Khoa reach for the bill at the same instant from opposite sides of the table, each pinching one end of it, lips pressed together.
The little bill tugs back and forth between them as @BaHoa narrows her eyes and @Khoa lifts his chin, neither letting go, grill smoke curling between them.
Both freeze and glare across the table with stubborn closed-mouth smiles, the paper bill stretched taut between their fingertips in the warm smoky sunlight.
clips.sfx: pork sizzling on charcoal, a paper bill crinkling, chopsticks clinking, street bustle
clips.setting: Bà Hoa's bustling bún chả shop on an old-quarter street by day: charcoal grills smoking on the pavement, low plastic stools, steel tables, baskets of fresh herbs, warm sunlight through the smoke.

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Ông Lâm lại đội mũ cối, chở cháu gái qua cổng Ô đi học, Mai đang viết một ứng dụng giúp sinh viên nhận ra các app cho vay lừa đảo, còn ông thì dựng xe dưới vòm cổng, đợi khách như chưa từng có chuyện gì.
beats: Golden morning light under the ancient brick city gate with its tiled roof, sparrows hopping on the old bricks and tangled wires overhead, the archway empty, no person in frame.
The old cream-colored step-through motorbike with a round chrome headlamp rolls slowly in under the arch carrying @Lam in front and @Mai behind him, a laptop hugged to her chest.
@Mai hops off, waves with a bright closed-mouth grin and strides away down the sunlit street with her small black backpack and laptop, while @Lam watches her go.
@Lam sets the motorbike on its stand under the gate, sits sideways on the seat and folds his arms, lips closed in a quiet smile as golden sunlight spills through the arch.
clips.sfx: sparrows chirping, an old engine puttering to a stop, a broom sweeping the pavement, a vendor's hand bell, distant motorbike horns

clips.speaker: @Lam
clips.line: Lâm Rồng nào cơ? Cậu nhầm người rồi, tôi chỉ là ông già xe ôm thôi, nhưng cứ ngồi lên xe đi, rồi kể tôi nghe xem đứa nào đang bắt nạt cậu.
beats: A young man in a delivery jacket approaches @Lam from screen-right, glances left and right, then points a hesitant finger at @Lam's right sleeve with eyebrows raised, lips pressed shut.
@Lam looks up at him, tugs his sleeve down over his forearm and answers with a warm chuckle in a calm husky voice, face and lips clearly visible.
@Lam keeps talking warmly and pats the motorbike's back seat twice with his palm, while the young man listens with closed lips, his hunched shoulders slowly relaxing.
@Lam finishes, closes his mouth and gives a knowing wink as the young man climbs onto the back seat behind him in the golden light under the gate.
clips.sfx: sparrows chirping, shuffling footsteps, a palm patting a vinyl seat, the old engine coughing to life
clips.extras: a young man in a delivery jacket hugging his helmet to his chest

clips.speaker: NARRATOR
clips.line: Chiếc xe máy cũ chở vị khách mới len vào lòng phố, găng tơ đã tái xuất, phố cổ Hà Nội từ hôm nay lại có một con rồng thức giấc canh giữ, và phi vụ tiếp theo của bộ ba Rồng, Hổ, Báo đã bắt đầu.
beats: Golden morning aerial low over the ancient brick city gate with its tiled roof as the old cream-colored step-through motorbike with a round chrome headlamp, carrying two tiny riders, rolls out from under the arch.
The drone rises and pulls back as the little cream motorbike weaves into the narrow streets between tube houses, tangled wires and fluttering laundry, sunlight flaring off its chrome headlamp.
A flock of pigeons sweeps across the frame as the camera soars higher, the tiled roofs of the old quarter spreading out in every direction and glowing gold.
The camera hangs high above a vast sea of tiled roofs and the distant gleam of a lake, the whole old quarter of Hà Nội waking below in a grand sunlit panorama.
clips.sfx: a rising morning breeze, a flock of pigeons' wings fluttering, distant motorbike horns and bicycle bells, the old engine puttering away
clips.setting: Golden morning aerial over Hà Nội's old quarter: tiled roofs, the ancient brick city gate, a cream motorbike weaving into the streets.
clips.extras: two tiny distant riders on a cream motorbike far below, seen from high above
